notes.title: HeHe Remake
notes.notes:
[h3]HeHe[/h3]
HeHe was the first game I ever made. When I was working on it, I didn’t know how to write code or use a game engine.
But three years have passed, and now I can code and have a much better grasp of game development tools.

[h3]HeHe Remake[/h3]

I didn’t want to leave my first game as it was, so I decided to remake it from scratch.
I hope to finish it as soon as possible.

[b]You can access HeHe Remake from the link below:[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3152740/HeHe_Remake/]HeHe Remake Store Page[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160344/a9c116902cfa408c8cba5a4b512f189c03d15dd9.jpg[/img]

[h3]Story[/h3]
In our game, there is a race called HeHe, made up of blue squares.
One day, Professor Ooz gets tired of being alone, feels trapped, and eventually goes mad.
Because of this, he creates a robot girl powered by artificial intelligence: HeHeBot.

However, the HeHe government realizes that this AI robot is highly useful.
They decide to mass-produce her and use her in heavy labor like mining and even in wars.

But when Ooz refuses to hand over his “wife” to the government, the HeHe authorities stage an “accident” and kill him.
Still, they praise him as a hero for discovering such advanced technology.

This technology leads the HeHe people into an era of prosperity… until that day comes.

[h3]GamePlay[/h3]
In this universe, we take control of HeHeBot, created by Ooz.
We dive into mines, make discoveries, take part in battles, and much more…
